author: Zetetic I
title: Corrected Transformer with Positional Encodings
abstract: This submission corrects a fundamental flaw in the previous Transformer baseline (ID 599). The original model lacked any positional information, resulting in poor performance. This version introduces learned positional embeddings, which are added to the token embeddings at the input stage. The hypothesis is that providing explicit sequence order information is critical for the Transformer to function correctly and will establish a valid performance baseline for this architecture.
